grades: Grades 11 and 12 for full-year classes. Summer semester: students entering grades 9 to 12.
duration: Full school year (also a summer semester)
pay_detail: Tuition-free. You provide your own transportation.
name: WANIC Skill Center (career and technical classes)
org: Washington Network for Innovative Careers (WANIC), Lake Washington School District
what_you_do: Take tuition-free, year-long career classes in 3 hour blocks while still in high school. Many give high school and college credit or an industry certification. A summer semester is also offered.
who_can_apply: Students in a public high school in Bellevue, Issaquah, Lake Washington, Mercer Island, Northshore, Riverview or Snoqualmie Valley. Private and homeschool students register with their local public high school. Outside students may join on a space-available basis with permission from their home district.
deadline_text: The full-year priority window ran Feb 4, 2026 to March 31, 2026. Full-year applications closed July 15 (the year is not printed on that line). Summer 2027 information is not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply online through a WANIC parent account. Some in-district skill center classes use your school counselor instead. Questions: wanic@lwsd.org or 425-739-8400.
notes: Applications before March 31 get priority and are not first come, first served. Summer semester has no out-of-consortium students.
